description:
Soybean, Medicago, chickpea, pea and faba bean RNA-seq experiments held by askPulse (Expression Atlas, the Legume Information System for chickpea and pea, and faba bean studies quantified by askPulse): baseline (TPM by
tissue / developmental stage / treatment) and differential (stress, pathogen, genotype contrasts). query filters descriptions/labels (e.g. 'drought',
'grain', 'Fusarium'). Gives each experiment's assay groups (baseline) or contrasts (differential).
name: expression_experiments
